name: AutoBot T7
description: AutoBot T7 V0.1: runtime Collision World fixes plus autonomous Cube test driver.

collision-debug-overlay.name: Collision Debug Overlay
collision-debug-overlay.description: Shows Collision World object bounds and query metrics. Exact gameplay hitboxes remain NOT VERIFIED.

collision-trace-debug.name: Collision Trace Debug
collision-trace-debug.description: Expensive diagnostic mode. Traces nearby objects from StaticWorld through primitive creation, SpatialHash, query and renderer, and runs periodic invariants/parse stability checks.

collision-object-labels.name: Collision Object Labels
collision-object-labels.description: When Collision Trace Debug is enabled, labels nearby objects with source index, object ID, raw GameObjectType and final classification.

collision-debug-full-world.name: Collision Debug Draw Mode - FULL WORLD
collision-debug-full-world.description: Diagnostic only. OFF = QUERY ONLY. ON = draw CollisionWorld objects visible by the camera using a brute-force camera-region scan, independent of SpatialHash/queryRegion.

autobot-enabled.name: AutoBot Autonomous Test Driver
autobot-enabled.description: Lets AutoBot own Cube input using live GameState + CollisionWorld queries. Unsupported modes stop control safely. This is a test driver, not the full planner.
